title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
layout_note: (a) a single left-to-right row of four dashed stage frames with tensor sizes above each boundary; (b), behind a thick dashed vertical rule, two successive blocks drawn as two dashed columns.
grouping: Each stage is a dashed rounded frame titled 'Stage k' at its top and holding a thin Patch Merging (or Linear Embedding) box plus a large 'Swin Transformer Block' box, with the repeat count (x2, x6) at its bottom right. Panel (b) has two dashed rounded frames, one per block. Sub-captions '(a) Architecture' and '(b) Two Successive Swin Transformer Blocks' sit under the panels; a heavy dashed vertical rule separates them.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with black outlines; panel (a) is entirely black and white, the merging/embedding boxes are tall and narrow with vertical text. Panel (b) uses pastel fills: green LN, magenta W-MSA / SW-MSA, blue MLP, with circled-plus residual adds and z^l symbols in math type. Tensor shapes are typeset fractions (H/4 x W/4 x C) floating above the arrows between stages.
proposed_highlight: The shifted-window idea is shown by contrast: the two block columns in (b) are identical except that the magenta attention box reads W-MSA in one and SW-MSA in the other. In (a), the hierarchy is carried by the shape labels halving resolution and doubling channels at each stage boundary.
lesson: Put the tensor shape above each stage boundary as a typeset fraction (H/8 x W/8 x 2C) so the hierarchy is read off the labels without drawing feature pyramids.

arrangement.units: (a) four dashed rounded stage frames in one row, each titled 'Stage k' with a repeat count, after an unframed Patch Partition box; (b) behind a heavy dashed vertical rule, two dashed block frames side by side.
arrangement.inputs_as: a plain box labelled 'Images' with its shape H x W x 3 above it

insights.structure: Panel (a) is one row of four dashed stage frames, each a thin merging box plus a large block box with its repeat count, and panel (b) behind a heavy dashed rule shows two block columns side by side.
insights.data: No images are drawn; the data is carried by typeset tensor shapes above each stage boundary and by z^l symbols on the residual stream in (b).
insights.emphasis: Colour is reserved for panel (b), where the two otherwise identical block columns differ only in the magenta attention box (W-MSA vs SW-MSA).
insights.flow: Panel (a) runs left to right on straight arrows through the stage frames; panel (b) runs bottom to top in each column, with residual lines looping up the right side and one long line carrying the first block's output over to the second.
insights.avoid: The 'Swin Transformer Block' boxes in (a) share no colour or marker with the detailed blocks in (b), so the link between the two panels rests on the name alone.

notes: Venue written as arXiv: ICCV 2021 is remembered, not printed on the first page. year = arXiv preprint year (2103.14030). Fig. 2 (regular vs shifted window partition drawn over a faded photo, with a small key) is the companion figure for the shifted-window idea. Domain 'image-classification' has no domain volume yet.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
